notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least seven artifacts and/or enchantments; additional permanents beyond this minimum can reduce the mana needed.
description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Cast Mechanized Production by paying {2}{U}{U} while keeping at least seven Treasures on the battlefield, attaching it to a Treasure you control.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to and causing you to win the game.
